# Does your NY LLC owe a filing — and when?

> Free browser tool for New York LLCs: check whether your LLC likely owes a Beneficial Ownership Disclosure or an Attestation of Exemption under the NY LLC Transparency Act, see your filing deadline counted down, and organize the beneficial-owner details you'll need before you email NYDOS yourself.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
